replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
"Forth Make a forum post Title it [Name of the map] [Walls]"
It's [Walls] <Name of the map> <Version of the map> (not the version of minecraft with that you built it)

And you have to add a map.yml. You can found the Avicus YAML resources at http://docs.avicus.net/ (Currently broken)
